description: This file defines the Comments class responsible for writing cell comments and VML comments to XML format in an XLSX spreadsheet file. It handles serialization of comments, authors, and related metadata into the appropriate XML structure for Excel files.

classes.name: Comments
classes.description: Handles writing of comments and VML comments to XML in XLSX files.

methods.name: writeComments
methods.description: Serializes worksheet comments into XML format, including authors and comment texts.

methods.name: writeComment
methods.description: Writes individual comment data to XML.

methods.name: writeVMLComments
methods.description: Serializes VML (vector markup language) comments for comments display in Excel.

methods.name: writeVMLComment
methods.description: Writes individual VML comment geometry and style for each comment.
